text:
Zoe (Design): quick UX check: compact routing rules feel flat when collapsed. proposing two things: a subtle left accent for preview highlight + inline conflict microcopy instead of a global toast.
Ethan (PM): can you show a short mock? is this only compact rows?
Zoe (Design): yes compact first. mock attached. key goals: preserve density, make reorder affordance obvious, and make sim playback call out which rule matched.
Lena (Frontend): doable. plan: 4px left accent on active rule, show a 16px visible grab icon on hover, and increase touch hit area to 44x44. CSS snippet: ```css
.rule--preview { box-shadow: inset 4px 0 var(--accent); transition: box-shadow .2s; }
```
Marc (Eng): backend note: sim returns match_id now. we can add rule_name + short_reason (<=140 chars) in sim payload. will cap to avoid huge payloads.
Ava (A11y): SR guidance: announce full sentences via role=status with aria-atomic=true. e.g., "Preview: rule 'Block large files' matched because file size exceeded 50 MB." Also ensure focus outlines meet contrast and 3px minimum for touch targets.
Zoe (Design): sample inline validation copy: "Conflict with 'Allow - billing' 1 Show conflict details" — prefer inline CTA.
Ethan (PM): inline CTA is better for support. prioritize that and the sim highlight.
Lena (Frontend): implementation notes: animate accent for 200ms, throttle during continuous playback, and only auto-show callout for the first match. lazy-load full details on demand.
notify-bot: Created issue: product/routing-ui#4521 - "compact: preview highlight, visible reorder handle, inline conflict CTA, SR announcement"
Zoe (Design): thanks all 44d I'll update the mock with a darker accent (#004EA8) for contrast and post images. review tomorrow 9:00?
Ethan (PM): scheduled. thanks!
